title: Public Artifact Privacy & Redaction Policy
description: Fail-closed governance policy defining public publication boundaries, classification models, detection categories, and finding sanitization contracts for diagnostic artifacts and evidence summaries (Issue #11, WS-07 Slice 3).

private-raw.description: Raw, un-sanitized internal or device diagnostic captures (e.g. real-vehicle transcripts, raw logs, raw dumps). May contain raw VIN, MAC, UUID, paths. Strictly forbidden from public distribution or external publication. Must remain byte-truthful and immutable.

public-summary.description: Publication candidate derived from allowlisted fields and validated summaries. Must contain zero sensitive findings when evaluated by public_artifact_guard. Safe for public release, bug reports, and CI artifacts.

synthetic-canary.description: Test-only fixtures containing synthetic, non-real sensitive identifiers (e.g. synthetic VIN, MAC, UUID, customer IDs, GPS, user paths). Used exclusively to verify that the privacy guard detects leaks. Strictly forbidden from public distribution.

rule_categories.vehicle.vin.plain: Plain 17-character VIN in explicit vehicle or VIN context
rule_categories.vehicle.vin.fragmented: VIN split across ordered sequence/segment payload fragments
rule_categories.vehicle.vin.hex_ascii: 17-character VIN encoded as hex ASCII string (contiguous or segmented)
rule_categories.device.mac: Hardware MAC address in standard colon or hyphen notation
rule_categories.device.serial: Hardware/device serial number in explicit device context
rule_categories.subject.plate_or_customer_id: License plate, customer ID, client ID, or vehicle owner identifier
rule_categories.location.gps: Geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) present in the same record
rule_categories.host.user_path: User-home absolute filesystem paths on macOS, Linux, or Windows
rule_categories.correlation.timestamp_with_identity: Timestamp correlated with an identity (VIN, device, customer, MAC) in the same logical record

allowlist_rules.dtc_codes: Standard OBD-II Diagnostic Trouble Codes (e.g. P0300, U0100, B1234, C0040)
allowlist_rules.ecu_identifiers: Standard OBD-II ECU CAN IDs and hex addresses (e.g. 7E8, 7E0, 0x7E8)
allowlist_rules.protocol_labels: Industry standard OBD/CAN protocol names (e.g. ISO 15765-4 CAN 11/500)
allowlist_rules.git_hashes: 40-hex Git commit SHA or 64-hex SHA-256 digests
allowlist_rules.test_identifiers: Test case and scenario labels (e.g. TC-101, S3-M1)
allowlist_rules.aggregate_metrics: Numeric aggregate counts and statistics without personal context
allowlist_rules.project_banners: Project-owned titles, headers, and copyright notices
allowlist_rules.isolated_timestamps: Timestamps without an accompanying identity in the same record
